stemMarkdown: Pipe A can fill a cistern in 6 hours and pipe B can fill it in 14 hours. If both pipes are opened together, how long will they take to fill the cistern? (2 decimal places, in hours.)
solutionMarkdown: A's rate $= 1/6$ of the cistern per hour, B's rate $= 1/14$. Combined rate $= 1/6 + 1/14 = 0.2381$ per hour. Time together $= \dfrac{1}{1/6+1/14} = 4.20$ hours.
